name: ckam-release-7ea352d
purpose: CKAM release: add companies, head offices and warehouses from the ERP (guided "Add from the ERP" in Setup), and Category / Sub-category shown in the asset's summary with Correct Classification beside them
release_sha_note: release_sha / release_sha_short repeat release_commit / release_commit_short because ops/windows/deploy_ckam.ps1.template reads these two names to check that the package is the release it was asked to deploy
code_identical_to_138e67a_except: backend/app/erp/ (setup_from_erp.py new; router.py, schemas.py, warehouse.py: GET/POST /api/erp/companies[/create], GET/POST /api/erp/places[/create])
frontend (ErpCompaniesDialog, ErpPlacesDialog, AssetDetail summary, Companies and Places screens, labels; rebuilt frontend-dist)
code_identical_note: git diff --name-only 138e67a..7ea352d over the packaged paths lists exactly the backend/app/erp files and the frontend sources above. backend/constraints.txt (44 pins), alembic migrations, ops/windows and ops/db are byte-identical to 138e67a.
built_from: git archive of the committed tree 7ea352d (no working-tree or untracked files)
frontend_build: npm ci; VITE_APP_VERSION=7ea352d npm run build; npm run check:build
database_change: NONE. No migration in this release: production stays at e8a0c2d4f6b8 and `alembic upgrade head` is a no-op.

migration_notes.rollback: No schema change, so the previous release 138e67a can be started again from its release folder if needed (it understands the same schema). The change is four routes under /api/erp (companies, places) and the Setup screens.
migration_notes.never: Never start release 3b5e842 or older: it has the IF-01 file-read hole and cannot move assets on the current schema.

components.backend/app/: production backend code incl. app/alembic (migrations); no tests, no __pycache__
components.backend/scripts/create_owner.py: one-time first-owner bootstrap script (only script shipped)
components.frontend-dist/: built frontend (no source maps, self-hosted fonts)
components.ops/windows/: reference launcher, deploy, verify and rollback scripts + README (unchanged)
components.ops/db/: role-split, verify and least-privilege check SQL + runbook, for the DBA (not used by this deploy)

zip_sha256: not stored inside the zip (a file cannot contain its own hash): see MANIFEST.7ea352d.sha256.txt next to the zip, which lists the SHA-256 of the zip and of every file in this folder
